changelog: - **A language that failed to load once no longer stays broken through the offline cache.** The installed app keeps each language's files in its offline cache. When the site was asked for a language file it did not have, as a page left open from before an update can ask, it answered with the app's page instead of an error, and the offline cache kept that page as the language file: that language then kept failing to load in that version of the app. Only a real language file is kept now, in a new offline cache, so a page an earlier version kept is no longer used; it is not deleted and stays stored. The first attempt in such a page still fails.
